talking_points: Microsoft has reportedly snubbed Nscale's bid to expand its Texas data centre deal just as the British neocloud eyes a $35bn IPO.
US banking regulator the OCC has issued its first supervisory framework for AI use, worried about banks' AI agents going rogue.
Anthropic's IPO filing has reportedly reopened Wall Street's door to AI listings, while AMD and Amazon chase chip and startup deals worth billions.
